basic_details.job_title: RNU DDK Jammu Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 2 CopyEditor, Videographer Posts
basic_details.short_information: The Regional News Unit (RNU), Doordarshan Kendra, Jammu has invited applications from young professionals for empanelment and engagement as Casual Assignees in two categories, CopyEditor (language Dogri) and Videographer, at Rs.1500/- per day per shift. Applications in the prescribed format at Annexure A must be sent by Speed Post only to Incharge, Regional News Unit, Doordarshan Kendra, TaliMorh, Janipur, Jammu, and must reach on or before 18 December 2026. The notice is dated 18 November 2026.

Essential: degree / diploma in film & video editing from a recognized university. Essential: 2 year experience in the relevant field. | The age limit for both posts is printed as 21-50 years. The notice prints no age cut-off date and no age relaxation. For the full eligibility of each post, check the official notification.

important_instructions: Casual Assignees will be allotted duties/assignments on an "As and When Required Basis" for a maximum of seven days in a month. Casual Assignees are required to work in odd hours. Selected candidates cannot claim any right to a permanent/regular job under any advertised category, as engagements/deployments will be made purely on a casual basis in RNU, Jammu. There will be no application fee. No TA/DA will be paid for interview/audition/skill tests. Canvassing in any form will attract rejection of the application. DG (N&CA) reserves the right to reject/cancel the process of empanelment at any time.

content_sections.heading: About RNU, Doordarshan Kendra, Jammu
content_sections.text: The notice is issued by the Regional News Unit of Doordarshan Kendra, Jammu, and is signed by Ayushi Puri, Deputy Director (News)/RNU Head. It invites young professionals to be empanelled as Casual Assignees. Engagements are made purely on a casual basis in RNU, Jammu.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applications go to this address: Incharge, Regional News Unit, Doordarshan Kendra, TaliMorh, Janipur, Jammu. The notice prints no PIN code. Fill in the prescribed application format at Annexure A, which is printed in the notice. The form asks for name, date of birth, gender, parent's name, nationality, addresses, mobile number, qualifications, language proficiency and experience. Give an email id in the form. The form marks it as mandatory for communication. Affix a recent passport size photograph in the space provided on the form. Sign the declaration, with date and place. It says the assignment is casual and will not be considered for any future permanent employment. Attach photocopies of the required documents (see Enclosures). Send the application by Speed Post only. It should reach on or before 18 December 2026. Applications will not be received by hand or in person. RNU will not be held responsible for any postal delay. A separate detailed CV can also be submitted with the prescribed application format if more details need to be attached, but the prescribed proforma must be submitted in every case. The notice does not say what to write on the envelope.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Essential: degree from a recognized university. Essential: degree / diploma in Journalism / Mass Communication from a recognized university. Desirable: acquaintance with national / international affairs. Desirable: matriculate in the relevant language. Desirable: 3 years experience of work relating to news in a media organization, preferably broadcasting. Essential: 10+2 from a recognized Board. Essential: degree / diploma in film & video editing from a recognized university. Essential: 2 year experience in the relevant field. The age limit for both posts is printed as 21-50 years. The notice prints no age cut-off date and no age relaxation. For the full eligibility of each post, check the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: The notice gives a checklist of photocopies to attach to the application: Filled in application form Educational qualification certificate / marks sheets Proof of age (Birth Certificate / Matriculation certificate) Proof of residence (Residence/Nativity Certificate) Technical and professional certificates Experience certificates Applications without proper self-attested enclosures, attachments, documents or photocopies of original certificates will be summarily rejected, and no further correspondence will be entertained.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for RNU DDK Jammu Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach RNU, Doordarshan Kendra, Jammu on or before 18 December 2026. The notice says RNU will not be held responsible for any postal delay.

faq.question: Q2. How do I apply for the Casual Assignee posts at DDK Jammu?
faq.answer: Send the application in the prescribed format at Annexure A, with photocopies of the required documents, by Speed Post only to Incharge, Regional News Unit, Doordarshan Kendra, TaliMorh, Janipur, Jammu.

faq.question: Q3. Can I submit the application by hand?
faq.answer: No. The notice says applications will not be received by hand or in person.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for CopyEditor (language Dogri)?
faq.answer: The essential qualification is a degree from a recognized university and a degree / diploma in Journalism / Mass Communication from a recognized university. Matriculation in the relevant language and 3 years' news-related media experience are desirable.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification for Videographer?
faq.answer: The essential qualification is 10+2 from a recognized Board, a degree / diploma in film & video editing from a recognized university, and 2 year experience in the relevant field.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for these posts?
faq.answer: The age limit is 21-50 years for both CopyEditor (language Dogri) and Videographer.

faq.question: Q7. How much is the pay?
faq.answer: The remuneration fee is Rs.1500/- per day per shift for both posts.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: No. The notice says there will be no application fee.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. Engagement is purely on a casual basis, and selected candidates cannot claim any right to a permanent/regular job.

faq.question: Q10. How many days a month will a Casual Assignee work?
faq.answer: Duties are allotted on an "As and When Required Basis" for a maximum of seven days in a month, and Casual Assignees are required to work in odd hours.
